crossrefs.text: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, in the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.
But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. And God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.
Then a meal was set before the man, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I came to say.” So Laban said, “Please speak.”
So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.
Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took it into Abinadabʼs house on the hill. And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD.
Now David was the son of a man named Jesse, an Ephrathite from Bethlehem of Judah who had eight sons in the days of Saul. And Jesse was old and well along in years.
Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.
O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.”
And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.
You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk in My law as you have walked before Me.’
But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind, for He is not a man, that He should change His mind.”

Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk before Me as you have done.’
He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
